subject: Supplier record update: remittance split & contact change
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fairviewmed.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@fairviewmed.com>
Date: 2026-03-09T10:12:00Z
Subject: Supplier record update: remittance split & contact change

Hi Mina,

Hope you're well — following our onboarding last month, we need to update Fairview Medical Supplies' vendor record to reflect a split remittance setup and to change the primary AP contact on file. Summary below: 

- Primary legal name remains: Fairview Medical Supplies, Inc. (EIN 12-3456789)
- Remittance: split by currency. USD -> Account A (ACH), EUR -> Account B (SEPA/SWIFT). We included IBAN/SWIFT for the EUR account in the attached bank letter.
- New remit preference: prefer ACH for USD invoices; wire only by prior approval.
- Remit address update for paper checks: 210 Meridian Ave, Accounts Payable, Suite 400, Port City, NY 10012
- Change portal owner to Elena Morales (elena.morales@fairviewmed.com) so our AP lead can manage 3-way matching and invoice inquiries.

Attached: Fairview_Supplier_Update_Form.pdf, Fairview_W9.pdf.

Can you let us know what supporting docs you need to complete this in your system and whether this will require a new vendor record or can be added to the existing one? We need the change effective for invoices dated 2026-03-15 and onward.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
AP Director
Fairview Medical Supplies

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fairviewmed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-09T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Supplier record update: remittance split & contact change

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and for the attachments. Quick confirmation items so we can process this cleanly: 

1) Can you attach a bank letter (on bank letterhead) or a voided ACH deposit slip for the USD account? We need bank verification to add a new ACH remit account.
2) For the EUR account, please confirm the full SWIFT/BIC and the beneficiary name exactly as it appears on the bank account.
3) Please confirm whether invoices should continue to route to invoices@fairviewmed.com or to Elena directly. If Elena will own invoice receipt in the portal, we need explicit consent for our routing change.

Looping in KarThik from procurement to note any PO implications — karthik, will a remit-by-currency rule require changes to the PO/payable instructions for existing POs or can AP handle this mapping?

I’ll hold the effective date in the ticket until we receive the bank verification.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fairviewmed.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Supplier record update: remittance split & contact change

Thanks, Mina and Elena. A couple of operational questions from procurement side: 

- Legal entity check: please confirm that invoices are issued to Redwood Inference, Inc. (no change expected, but call out if Fairview uses an alternate remittance name).
- PO routing: if Fairview wants remittance split by currency automatically, AP will generally route payments by currency at pay run time. We don’t require separate POs for different currencies, but we need a sample invoice showing the currency-coded line items so Payables can validate the mapping.
- For EUR wires, please include SWIFT and an intermediary bank if applicable.

If you can reply with a sample invoice (PDF) and the bank verification, procurement and AP can approve the mapping and we’ll update the vendor record.

-Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T15:40:00Z

Hi Karthik / Mina — thanks for the quick responses. Attaching the bank letter (Fairview_Bank_Letter.pdf) and a sample invoice (Fairview_Sample_Invoice.pdf) that shows currency = EUR on one line and USD on another. SWIFT: FBINUS33; no intermediary bank. Beneficiary name: Fairview Medical Supplies, Inc.

Forwarding KarThik's questions below for traceability.

Elena / Team — thanks for the bank letter and sample invoice. We have everything we need to proceed: 

- Action: Vendor record will be updated to add two remit accounts (USD ACH Account A; EUR IBAN Account B) and remit-by-currency routing enabled.
- Portal ownership: updated to elena.morales@fairviewmed.com for exception handling; invoices will continue to copy invoices@fairviewmed.com.
- Effective date: changes will be scheduled for the 2026-03-15 pay cycle. Please allow 48 business hours for AP mapping; we will confirm once live.

Attachments processed: Fairview_Supplier_Update_Form.pdf, Fairview_W9.pdf, Fairview_Bank_Letter.pdf, Fairview_Sample_Invoice.pdf

If you need change control (e.g., prevent routing changes for certain legacy POs), reply with PO numbers and we can set PO-level overrides.

I'll close the procurement ticket once AP confirms the first successful remittance under the new mapping.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad

Redwood Inference
